claims_and_calculations.claim: Cereals are dried/stored/processed; packaging covers consumer/distribution/transport systems. Bakery/retail bread waste is used as pig feed; household waste destinations are modeled treatment mixtures. Bran remains coproduct mass, not classified as disappearance.

LCA describes tests of firmness/perceived freshness and explicitly asks for larger tests in actual value chain; these do not identify causal weighed household-discard reduction. Survey studies associations and reported intentions/behavior.
